terminal.title: Interactive terminal
terminal.intro: Start an explicitly authorized shell in its own attempt worktree. Terminal output and process exit do not approve a task or prove tests passed.
terminal.select_task: Choose a task above before creating or viewing its terminal sessions.
terminal.recent_sessions: Showing up to 20 recent sessions for this task, plus the current session if it is outside that page. This is not the complete history.
terminal.profiles_partial: The terminal profile catalog is bounded and incomplete. An empty page does not prove no other profile exists.
terminal.no_sessions: No terminal session has been created for this task.
terminal.no_profile: No currently authorized terminal profile is available. Configure a PTY-capable Runner before continuing.
terminal.consent: I authorize an interactive shell in this task's separate attempt worktree. It can run programs and change files; the editor's shared directory is not used.
terminal.detach_hint: Closing or disconnecting this view does not confirm the shell stopped. Reconnecting resumes the same session; it does not start another shell.
terminal.stop_pending: Stop requested. Wait for the Runner's actual process-tree stop result.
terminal.too_much_output: Too much output to announce. Navigate the terminal rows to read the remaining content.
terminal.input_unknown: Delivery of the previous input is unknown. It will not be resent automatically. Inspect this session before deciding whether to enter new input.
terminal.input_unknown_reviewed: Session reviewed. Previous input delivery remains unknown and was not replayed. Entering new input does not change that fact.
terminal.input_rejected: Some input was not sent or was rejected. It has not been replayed. Check the terminal before entering more text; a single input must not exceed 8 KiB.
terminal.input_accepted: Input accepted for delivery. This does not mean the shell executed it.
terminal.input_delivered: Previous input bytes were delivered to the PTY. Command completion remains separate.
terminal.output_gap: Some earlier output is no longer retained. The visible history is incomplete.
terminal.read_only: Viewing only. Input and shell control require current creator permission.
terminal.access_changed: Access changed. Protected terminal output is hidden and no new input is sent.
terminal.pending: The original session or control request is awaiting confirmation. Recover that request; do not create another shell.
terminal.invalid_read: The terminal response could not be verified. Check the original session.
terminal.load_failed: The terminal renderer could not load. Refresh the application before reconnecting.
terminal.connection.retrying: Connection interrupted; reconnecting to the same session
terminal.recovery.title: Review interrupted execution
terminal.recovery.intro: Review the original session and execution only. Closing it as failed requires persisted process-tree stop proof and individual review of every unknown input. No shell or input is replayed.
terminal.recovery.tree_stopped: Original process-tree stop is proven. This does not prove unknown input executed.
terminal.recovery.tree_unknown: Original process-tree stop is not proven. This execution cannot be closed; wait for its Runner to report.
terminal.recovery.inputs_unknown: These inputs still have unknown delivery. Each acknowledgement accepts that uncertainty; it does not mark delivery or resend input.
terminal.recovery.input_ack: I reviewed input {{sequence}} and accept that its delivery remains unknown.
terminal.recovery.reason_hint: Describe the facts reviewed, up to 2,000 UTF-8 bytes.
terminal.recovery.consent: I confirm closing this original execution as failed. This does not prove command success, tests or task acceptance.
terminal.recovery.pending: The close result is awaiting confirmation. Check the same original request; do not recreate the execution or replay input.
terminal.recovery.completed: Original execution closed as failed. Unknown inputs remain unknown and were not replayed.
terminal.candidate.title: Send terminal changes to quality checks
terminal.candidate.intro: Preview the fixed changes from a stopped session, then separately authorize checks and sealing. Shell-start consent does not cover this action. Previewing does not run checks or change the task run.
terminal.candidate.choose_plan: Choose a saved plan or new preview
terminal.candidate.recent_plans: Showing up to 20 recent delivery plans for this original session. Reading or selecting a plan does not restart execution. Started plans retain their original facts when the current business basis changes.
terminal.candidate.stop_required: The original session must end with proven process-tree stop, a stopped snapshot and any unknown execution reviewed. Complete 'Review interrupted execution' above first.
terminal.candidate.profile: Check profile on the original Runner
terminal.candidate.workflow_hint: The workflow requires one fixed-command check and one independent test consuming its candidate. The check uses the original terminal Runner; the independent test uses another Runner.
terminal.candidate.no_profile: No loaded profile matches the workflow command, is currently available and writable, and belongs to the original Runner. Load more profiles or configure one in execution tools.
terminal.candidate.no_workflow: No eligible published workflow is available. Configure a fixed check command and independent candidate test, then return to preview.
terminal.candidate.profile_page: Loaded {{loaded}} of {{total}} execution profiles. Selection covers loaded items only.
terminal.candidate.preview_consent: I authorize reading this stopped session's fixed changes and creating a delivery preview. I will separately confirm whether to start checks and sealing after review.
terminal.candidate.started: Checks and candidate quality workflow started
terminal.candidate.boundary: Candidate sealing, independent tests of the same commit, human acceptance and issue follow-up retain their own actual results. This action does not accept the task.
terminal.candidate.expires: Preview expires {{at}}. Starting rechecks current access and basis.
terminal.candidate.start_consent: I reviewed the fixed source and task basis, and authorize this check and seal workflow with another Runner testing the same candidate commit.
terminal.candidate.open_run: View checks, candidate and independent tests
terminal.candidate.open_task: Open task acceptance and issue follow-up
terminal.candidate.pending: The original delivery preview or start is awaiting confirmation. Check that same request; do not create another candidate or start again.
terminal.handoff.title: Hand off accepted baseline
terminal.handoff.intro: After formal task acceptance, bind this run's exact candidate as another unstarted task's code baseline. This only binds the baseline; it does not create or start follow-up execution.
terminal.handoff.acceptance_required: The source task must have current formal acceptance, this exact successful run and its independent test evidence. Complete task acceptance and refresh here. A successful run alone is not acceptance.
terminal.handoff.task_page: Loaded {{loaded}} of {{total}} tasks. Selection covers other loaded tasks that have not started.
terminal.handoff.unavailable: This target cannot currently bind a baseline. Check whether it started or its basis changed.
terminal.handoff.reason_hint: Explain why this accepted candidate is the follow-up task's baseline, up to 2,000 UTF-8 bytes.
terminal.handoff.consent: I confirm binding this accepted run's exact candidate as the selected task's code baseline. The follow-up still requires separate dispatch and acceptance.
terminal.handoff.bound: Target baseline bound. Follow-up execution has not started.
terminal.handoff.pending: The original baseline binding is awaiting confirmation. Check that same request; do not switch targets or repeat the handoff.
